comingLast.roast: 6 left, 3 needed, one bar holding its breath
2 clear - his supporters (his group) keep reminding him loudly
3 points of daylight - barely enough to read by
4 points is all that separates him from a very blue evening
above the blue balls by 4 - margin thinner than the clubhouse gravy
5 clear with holes in hand - the maths likes him, the course may not
clear of Somerville by 5 - nobody tell him, he plays worse informed
